notes.title: 3.8 Patch
notes.notes:
Some players were having issues with the game automatically defaulting to 1080p resolution on launch with incompatible monitors.

The game now automatically detects and sets your monitors highest supported screen resolution at launch, which includes ultra-wide and 4k supported monitors.

The game is very well optimised so it should run fine using your native resolution. If however you're finding the game to run choppy. You can lower the resolution using the buttons in the lower section of the UI menu.

notes.title: 3.0 Update has started.
notes.notes:
3.0 will include the house been fully decorated and polished. (It's very white-washy, and bland right now) It will look just as nice as the bedroom for 3.0

One man team to a Four man team.
A concept artist, character artist, animator, and myself will now be working on the game leading up to the 3.0 update.

VR Stand-alone will be the priority. The game will be 100% VR compatible. Absolutely nothing will be compromised to create a fully immersive VR experience. No more 2D UI, absolutely everything will work in VR.

The game is going to be polished into a diamond.

Dates can not be given at this time, however I will try to keep you updated best I can.

The game as it stands I feel is nice, and people really seem to enjoy it. I really do see a lot more potential, and I want to make that happen.

Barry

notes.title: Darkness issue for some users.
notes.notes:
Update:

Boogeyman requires a Direct X11 compatible graphics card in order for eye adaptation to work. Direct x11 is listed as a minimum requirement for the game.

If your graphics card does not support DX11. You will experience extremely dark nights while exploring the house as the house exploration lighting relies heavily on eye adaptation. You can however still play the standard game mode just fine. Simply turn off explore house in the options.

(This option is currently not working, this will be patched later today) 

Priority list:
Brightness slider in options.
Fix skip explore house option not working.
Resolve achievements not been registered.
Fast and easy tutorial to explain the new features more clearly.

If anyone has any issues, even if you don't think it's very big, let me know.

Barry

notes.title: 2.0 - Yes It's finally here!
notes.notes:
Explore the house each night before you bunker down in your room for the nightly defence against the Boogeyman. The Boogeyman however will still be lurking around the house waiting for you to walk into that one dark room unaware.

Each night you must find your flash-light that you have left somewhere around the house. Stay in the light and turn light switches on as much as possible, staying in the dark is dangerous.

•	Hold F to open doors, and peek inside, make sure to let go and slam it as fast as you can if you see him waiting for you in there, or his hands begin to wrap around the door.

•	Find hidden cassette tapes around the house, and use them on the tape recorder in the living room. Revealing a very different story to the bedroom tapes.

•	Explore and discover notes / books and clues around the house.

You may also find useful items around the house to aid you during the night in your room:

•	Coffee will temporarily make time seem to pass faster. Using it when you’re close to the end of the night and low on battery will surely be a life saver.

•	Cherry bombs can be used when you’re in a pinch, giving you them few precious seconds of safety to look under the bed after letting one off to scare the Boogeyman away.

•	Glow sticks can be placed around the room to help you see the darker corners of your room. Helping you to see much more clearly without relying on your flashlight.

•	Fully working difficulty system: The Boogeyman will now move much more slowly… or faster depending on the difficulty. Your battery meter colour will indicate what difficulty setting you are on. Blue = Easy, Green = Medium, Red = Hard.

•	The game has been optimised even more, for a smoother experience.

notes.title: 1.2.7 Information galore
notes.notes:
•	VR menu issues resolved
•	Subtle visual polish
•	Slight changes to tutorial
•	2.0 update ‘under the hood’ preparation

This was mainly a VR update. VR will no longer have menu buttons. When you use VR it will boot straight into the game. When you complete a night it will go right onto the next, no more finicky menu buttons. If you need to change any settings, please do so in standard mode, all settings will be saved for when you boot up in VR. To exit VR and quit the game, press ALT + Enter.

VR will get its very own balanced version of the game. It’s understandably much more difficult using a VR headset, and I will make sure the gameplay adjusts accordingly to take this into account in future updates. VR right now is more of a fun extra, and certainly changes the way you play the game. It would be unfair to keep certain aspects for VR users. I’ll make sure it’s enjoyable, with a balance of challenge and enjoyably.

Future update info
•	2.0 will be out hopefully in early January. (50% more gameplay / story)
•	Nightmare mode, and achievements will follow soon after. (2-3 weeks)
•	Finishing touches will be made, and the game declared finished. (This will not be rushed)
•	Language support for Russian, German, Brazil, French, and Polish. (Subtitles, or fully dubbed)

2.0 will feature a full house to explore and interact with. New gameplay mechanics with story content is also included that will reveal the full backstory to the origins of the Boogeyman... and many secrets Alicia and Elle have been hiding. I will keep the rest of the surprises hush until release. I will just say that there is enough content been added that it could have been made into a large DLC pack or Boogeyman 2 sequel game in itself. I was strongly advised to do just that. I made a promise, which was that all updates to this game will forever be free. This will never change, rest assured. I have now publicly confirmed this.

notes.title: Steam Cloud + Save files
notes.notes:
Save games were often deleted or wiped during updates.
Steam Cloud is now all up and running for the game, which should save your progress to the cloud from now on. So updates should now leave your save game intact.

Note for mobile / capped broadband:

Epic just released their latest and greatest update to the Unreal Engine 4 (4.10). It fixes a lot of issues with the Oculus Rift, and is far more optimised. The engine in general has also been updated with hundreds of improvements, fixes, optimisations, among other useful things. The update was too big to ignore. The update however did break a lot of stuff in game… as is usually the case.

I spent the last couple of days fixing everything and making sure it all works. I’m now just gluing my hair back onto my head, and I’ll be back working on the actual game again.

notes.title: Five Nights Of Fear: Boogeyman
notes.notes:
The Boogeyman (Bogeyman in my lingo) is your typical nightmare creature. An anti Santa Clause, in that it is a threat rather than a promise. Of course, Daddy Christmas can be used as a threat as well: “If you don’t behave, no presents!” That’s a damn sight less intimidating than “tidy your room or a hideous supernatural entity will creep out of your closet and eat you from the toes right up to the scalp” though.

Boogeyman [Steam Page], currently in Early Access, is a game about that entity. It’s a bit like Five Nights at Freddy’s crossed with Among the Sleep.

… [visit site to read more]
